question: After how many Minutes Half Time starts in a Hockey match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**30 Minutes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Half time** in a hockey match is a **10-minute break** between the** two halves** of the game.
 
• Hockey is a sport that is played on a field or an ice rink, and it is a **team sport** that involves **two teams of eleven players** each.
 
• The game is played in two halves of **30 minutes** each, with a 10-minute break in between.
 
• During half time, players can **rest, rehydrate, and strategize **for the second half of the game.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All of the men's and women's field hockey events in India are organized, managed, and carried out by **Hockey India.**
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India**, acknowledges it as the only organization in charge of advancing the sport.
 
• After the** Indian Hockey Federation** was disbanded in 2008, it was established.
 
• On** July 24, 2008**, Hockey India held a ceremony to unveil their own logo.
 
• It is similar to the Indian flag's **Ashok Chakra.**
 
• It is constructed with **hockey sticks.**
